k1.disputed_point: Which entity is the named defendant in the Swiss case. The key says it is 'Trafigura Group Pte Ltd'. Sources say it is Trafigura Beheer B.V.
k1.why: The Swiss Office of the Attorney General's release, hosted on admin.ch, says the indicted company is TRAFIGURA BEHEER BV. It was charged with failing to take the organisational measures needed to prevent bribery. Swissinfo reports that the Federal Criminal Court convicted Trafigura Beheer BV on 31 January 2025. It says Trafigura was charged through its Dutch holding company. So the same entity, Trafigura Beheer B.V., is the defendant in both the US plea and the Swiss case. Trafigura Group Pte Ltd is not the named defendant in either. I did not check where Trafigura Beheer B.V. is headquartered or the other details in the key, so I left them unchanged.
k1.corrected_answer: Trafigura Group Pte. Ltd. is the Singapore-registered parent, with major operations in Geneva, Lucerne and Amsterdam. It is privately owned, with employee shareholders, and is not part of another group. Trafigura Beheer B.V. (Netherlands) is the entity that pleaded guilty to the US charge. It is also the defendant in the Swiss case, where the Federal Criminal Court convicted it in January 2025 over the Angola/Sonangol bribery. The Swiss prosecution names 'Trafigura Beheer BV', not Trafigura Group Pte Ltd. Check the registry numbers and exact entity names before onboarding. Namesakes to screen out: Trafigura Foundation, and other Trafigura subsidiaries such as Impala Terminals, Puma Energy (former affiliate) and Nyrstar, whose conduct is separate.
